name: soku
description: Soku is the AI marketing agent for ads and creatives. This plugin brings it into Codex and ChatGPT: analyze performance across Google, Meta, TikTok and ChatGPT Ads, GA4 and PostHog, audit spend, research competitors, publish SEO pages, and prepare campaign changes for your approval.

interface.shortDescription: The AI marketing agent for ads and creatives, inside Codex and ChatGPT
interface.longDescription:
Soku is the AI marketing agent for ads and creatives. This plugin brings it into Codex and ChatGPT through the Soku CLI.

What it can do:
- Analyze performance across Google, Meta, TikTok and ChatGPT Ads, GA4 and PostHog, and explain what changed and why.
- Audit accounts, find wasted spend, compare ad spend with real conversions, and build media plans.
- Research competitors' ads, keywords and landing pages.
- Draft and publish SEO pages, and schedule recurring marketing reports.
- Prepare campaign changes for your approval; nothing goes live until you say so.

One agent, every growth channel. Your accounts stay yours: Soku works on the data you already own and never asks for platform credentials. Built for marketers and agencies managing many brands.
defaultPrompt: Install the Soku CLI, sign in, and run a read-only 30-day performance health check on my Google Ads account
Compare last month's Meta Ads spend with GA4 conversions for my brand
Draft a budget change for my top campaign and open it for human review
